snippets: Use AI-generated imagery/video to create or verify an account on Fiverr, with the purpose of impersonating another person, or misrepresenting yourself, is prohibited.
Write misleading content in your profile description, profession profile, skills section, professional background, and/or education is prohibited.
Copy Gig descriptions, packages, and/or other content from another user's Gig listing, their profile page or profession profile is prohibited.
Raise the price of your Gig service in personal messages before or after purchase.
Attempts to manipulate the review system, whether directly or indirectly, are prohibited and may result in immediate permanent suspension of any related accounts.
We also welcome the rise of tools like AI that help creators move faster, think bigger, and do more.
